question.text: For an isosceles prism of angle <math><mi>A</mi></math> and refractive index <math><mi>μ</mi></math> it is found that, the angle of minimum deviation is <math><msub><mrow><mi> </mi><mi>δ</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>A</mi></math>. Which of the following options is/are correct?

options.text: For this prism, the emergent ray at the second surface will be tangential to the surface when the angle of incidence at the first surface is <math><msub><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mo>[</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow></mrow><msqrt><mn>4</mn><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></msqrt><mo>-</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>]</mo></mrow></mrow></math>

For the angle of incidence <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>i</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>A</mi></math>, the ray inside the prism is parallel to the base of the prism.

At minimum deviation, the incident angle <math><mi> </mi><msub><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and the refracting angle <math><msub><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> at the first refracting surface are related by <math><msub><mrow><mi>r</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></math>

For this prism, the refractive index  <math><mi>μ</mi></math>  and the angle of prism  <math><mi>A</mi></math>  are related as  <math><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cos</mi></mrow><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>μ</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow></math>
